Monthly account insights from the Instagram Graph API cover July to October. Output comes from the Publishing Log and website sessions from GA4.
Follower totals for July to October are estimates reconstructed from account snapshots and recorded follows and unfollows. For 29 September to 29 October, the app recorded +452 and the API +493.
Reach counts unique accounts each month. Monthly reach cannot be added together. Months with 31 days cover the first 30.
Post metrics use the latest available data within the reporting period. October posts use snapshots from 30 October, which lack post follows. Meta provides no follows or profile visits for Reels.
Organic Social sessions include other social platforms and Story link stickers.
